However, these recommendations primarily address acute administration, whereas chronic preoperative benzodiazepine use for non-surgical indications remains incompletely understood, and the relevant evidence has not been comprehensively synthesised. This scoping review characterised the literature on chronic preoperative benzodiazepine use and perioperative outcomes by mapping study characteristic

item.title: [British Journal of Anaesthesia] Reference values and web-based tool for intraoperative heart rate and blood pressure in paediatric patients undergoing general anaesthesia for noncardiac procedures
item.description: Heart rate (HR) and arterial blood pressure (BP) monitoring is standard of care during paediatric anaesthesia, yet evidence-based reference values for anaesthetised children remain limited. Existing BP reference values do not account for the combined effects of age, sex, weight, and height, and HR reference values in this population are lacking.
